verdict.rationale: TrueLayer offers Data API bank connections and stored account details with consent, so a documented way to sever connections and purge data is a fair question. Nothing in the evidence pack documents deleting a connection or user, revoking consent, stopping data collection, or purging held data. The mentions of consent setup and reuse do not cover deletion or cleanup.

support.subject: As an ops lead, I can sever and clean up — a documented way to delete a connection or user and have the platform stop collecting and purge held data
